label: D1 after an a1 -> S1 common trial (late in episode)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO or D2), and only when the previous trial was a1 with a common transition to S1. Whenever the previous trial is known, it never fires after a2 or after a rare transition: (phase==D1)&(prev_action!=2)&(prev_state!=2) has recall 1.0 but precision 0.18. The misses are rel -3 D1 steps, where the previous trial falls outside the window. Its rate also rises over the episode, peaking at trials 50-89 and close to silent before trial 10 and after trial 90; adding that ep_trial window lifts dev F1 to 0.43 with mass recall 0.88. Magnitude is largest when that a1->S1 trial went unrewarded (r0 at D1): adding prev_reward==0 raises precision to 0.57 and covers 82% of the top activation quartile. After a rewarded a1->S1 trial it fires weakly, or not at all. It co-occurs with a moderate a1 preference (choice logit about 2.8-8, value below about 7.7) and is silent when a1 is strongly preferred or when a2 is preferred. All predicates use only observed variables. Precision stays low, so the predicate describes the context the feature needs, not what decides whether it fires.
